title: Geometry-tunable magnetic edge contrast in Bi2Te3 Corbino nanoplates
summary: Two-dimensional topological insulators feature helical edge states that are remarkably resistant to disorder, making them appeal for energy-efficient electronics and quantum information technologies. In this study, we develop a Te-rod-templated solution growth method to create Bi2Te3 nanoplates with a Corbino geometry. The resulting few-quintuple-layer hexagonal plates are single-crystalline and contain well-defined central pores.
